questions.q: What do you do with the Raspberry Pi UART before connecting the FC?
options: Remove the console from the port
Set the speed to 9600 for reliability
questions.explain: Remove the Linux console from the port (raspi-config) and enable the hardware port — otherwise the console holds the port.
Normal for short wires; for long ones use 57 (57600).
mavlink-router or mavp2p serve the stream over UDP/TCP.

questions.q: Why is the script run as a systemd service?
questions.explain: A script started over SSH dies with the session.

questions.q: The Pi shut down in flight. What happens to the FC?
options: Goes to RTL on a timeout
questions.explain: The FC keeps working; after the Pi powers back on, the service comes up by itself.

questions.q: Why is Bluetooth disabled on a Pi 4 for the UART?
questions.explain: Bluetooth takes the full UART, and the mini-UART is unstable at 921600: dtoverlay=disable-bt.

questions.q: How do scripts connect when mavlink-router is used?
options: Through an SSH tunnel to the port
questions.explain: Otherwise they get in each other's way.

options: Undervoltage and throttling have occurred since boot
questions.explain: Bits 16 and 18 — undervoltage and throttling have occurred; bits 0–3 — they are happening now.
